lead.headline: Circle's bank charter and Swift's tokenized deposit pilot mark institutional infrastructure's tipping point
lead.tldr: This week, traditional finance's plumbing went on-chain: Circle secured a national trust bank charter while Swift launched a blockchain ledger for 17-bank tokenized deposits, even as Paradigm's $1.2B fund expansion signals capital is chasing the AI-crypto convergence rather than pure-play Web3.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, this week institutional infrastructure crossed from pilot to production while venture capital redefined its frontier, reshaping where we underwrite value for the next twelve months.

top_signals.title: Announcing Our Fourth Fund
top_signals.summary: Paradigm has announced the launch of its fourth fund, raising $1.2 billion. The capital is intended to support ambitious builders working at the frontier of technology and Web3.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Paradigm's $1.2B fourth fund, with its explicit expansion into AI and robotics, signals that even the most crypto-native institutional capital is repricing pure blockchain exposure and seeking optionality across frontier tech convergence plays.

top_signals.title: Housing bill that includes a CBDC ban passed into law without Trump's signature
top_signals.summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act has officially become law, incorporating a critical provision that prohibits the Federal Reserve from issuing a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC). The bill passed into law without requiring a signature from President Trump.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The CBDC ban becoming law without Trump's signature reveals bipartisan legislative momentum against state-controlled digital currencies, structurally advantaging private stablecoin issuers like Circle and narrowing the competitive design space for Fed-led alternatives.

top_signals.title: USDC issuer Circle wins final approval for US national trust bank charter20m
top_signals.summary: Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, has received final approval for a US national trust bank charter. This regulatory milestone allows the company to operate as a federally chartered bank, enhancing its legitimacy and operational capabilities within the US financial system.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Circle's national trust bank charter is a watershed for stablecoin legitimacy, transforming USDC from a regulatory gray-zone instrument into a federally supervised banking product that can directly access Fed master accounts and compete on equal footing with traditional deposits.

top_signals.title: Tarun Chitra's Gauntlet raises $125 million Series C from sole investor SBI Holdings
top_signals.summary: Gauntlet, founded by Tarun Chitra, has raised $125 million in a Series C funding round. The investment was provided solely by SBI Holdings to support the growth of DeFi, tokenization, and vaults.
top_signals.why_it_matters: SBI Holdings' sole-investor $125M Series C in Gauntlet validates that institutional Japanese capital is underwriting DeFi infrastructure at scale, specifically the risk modeling and vault mechanisms required for tokenized asset protocols to attract traditional balance sheets.

top_signals.title: Swift launches blockchain ledger for tokenized deposit pilot with 17 banks
top_signals.summary: Swift has launched a blockchain-based ledger to facilitate a pilot program for 24/7 cross-border payments. The initiative involves 17 banks utilizing tokenized deposits to streamline international transfers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Swift's 17-bank tokenized deposit pilot on a dedicated blockchain ledger demonstrates that the world's dominant interbank messaging network is treating on-chain settlement as a production-grade alternative to correspondent banking, not an experiment.

top_signals.title: SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilot31m, SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilotSWIFT launched its new blockchain ledger that will host a tokenized bank deposit pilot for 17 major banks seeking faster cross-border payments.
top_signals.summary: SWIFT has launched a new blockchain ledger to facilitate a tokenized deposit pilot involving 17 major banks. The initiative aims to significantly increase the speed and efficiency of cross-border payments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The duplication of Swift's tokenized deposit announcement across multiple signals confirms this is not a marginal initiative but a coordinated institutional push to migrate cross-border payment rails onto programmable ledgers, with 24/7 settlement as the immediate value proposition.

deals.summary: Paradigm has announced the launch of its fourth fund, raising $1.2 billion. The capital is intended to support ambitious builders working at the frontier of technology and Web3.
Gauntlet, founded by Tarun Chitra, has raised $125 million in a Series C funding round. The investment was provided solely by SBI Holdings to support the growth of DeFi, tokenization, and vaults.

KOR Protocol has raised $7.5 million in a Series A funding round led by 1kx and Blockchain Capital. The project is developing an onchain clearinghouse designed to register creative works and automate payments to rights holders.

M1X Global has raised $5.5 million in a seed round led by Paradigm to expand its tokenized sovereign debt platform. The company previously collaborated with the Republic of the Marshall Islands to issue the onchain sovereign bond USDM1.

on_the_radar.title: SEC plans crypto rule changes for exchanges and broker dealers in 2026 regulatory agenda
on_the_radar.summary: The SEC has included plans to implement cryptocurrency rule changes for exchanges and broker-dealers in its 2026 regulatory agenda. This move signals a shift toward establishing a formal regulatory blueprint for digital asset intermediaries.

on_the_radar.title: Multi-trillion-dollar asset manager Vanguard hiring crypto exec to help influence market
on_the_radar.summary: Vanguard, a multi-trillion-dollar asset manager, is hiring a crypto executive to lead its digital asset strategy. The new head of digital assets will focus on personal wealth clients and regulatory engagement.

on_the_radar.title: Ripple secures full MiCA license for crypto services across Europe30m
on_the_radar.summary: Ripple has successfully secured a full MiCA license, allowing it to provide crypto services across the European Union. This regulatory milestone enables the company to expand its operational footprint and offer compliant services in a major global market.

on_the_radar.title: TeraWulf signs 20-year data center lease with Anthropic expected to generate $19 billion in revenue
on_the_radar.summary: TeraWulf has entered into a 20-year data center lease agreement with AI company Anthropic. The deal involves the Justified Data site in Kentucky and is projected to generate $19 billion in revenue.

on_the_radar.title: Circle wins licence for some US banking activities
on_the_radar.summary: Circle has been granted a license to operate as a trust bank, allowing it to engage in specific US banking activities. This regulatory approval is seen as a significant step for the stablecoin issuer's integration with traditional financial systems.

on_the_radar.title: Phantom, Hyperliquid ask CFTC to modernize rules for onchain derivatives21m, Phantom, Hyperliquid ask CFTC to modernize rules for onchain derivatives
on_the_radar.summary: Phantom and Hyperliquid have formally petitioned the CFTC to modernize regulatory frameworks for onchain derivatives. The move aims to create a legal pathway for decentralized platforms to operate within US regulatory boundaries.

on_the_radar.title: MARA shares surge after 2 GW Texas infrastructure deal expands AI ambitions28m
on_the_radar.summary: MARA has entered a deal to expand its Texas infrastructure by 2 GW to support its ambitions in AI and Bitcoin mining. This strategic move led to a surge in the company's share price.

on_the_radar.title: PayPal seeks to increase use of PYUSD stablecoin with native issuance on Polygon
on_the_radar.summary: PayPal is expanding the utility of its PYUSD stablecoin by enabling native issuance on the Polygon network. The stablecoin will also be integrated into Polygon's Open Money Stack to increase adoption.

on_the_radar.title: CFTC Chair Selig warns regulators will end up 'writing all the rules' for crypto if Clarity Act stalls
on_the_radar.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig warned that regulatory agencies will be forced to establish their own rules for the crypto industry if Congress does not pass the Clarity Act. This highlights the tension between legislative action and regulatory oversight in the US.

on_the_radar.title: Sony Bank gets US regulator nod to issue stablecoins6m
on_the_radar.summary: Sony Bank has received approval from US regulators to issue stablecoins. This move signals a significant step toward integrating traditional banking infrastructure with digital asset issuance.

on_the_radar.title: INTERPOL-led global fraud crackdown arrests over 5,800, uncovers crypto laundering network tied to $122.5 million wallet
on_the_radar.summary: INTERPOL led a global crackdown on fraud resulting in over 5,800 arrests and the discovery of a sophisticated crypto laundering network. The operation highlighted the use of cross-chain swaps to obscure illicit funds, specifically identifying one wallet that processed $122.5 million in ten months.

on_the_radar.title: Hyundai Card completes its first real-world stablecoin pilot with Avalanche, Tether
on_the_radar.summary: Hyundai Card has successfully completed its first real-world stablecoin pilot utilizing Avalanche and Tether. The company is now expanding its efforts with a second Proof of Concept (PoC) involving Visa and Circle.

linkedin_post: A lot of people saw Paradigm's $1.2 billion fourth fund and filed it under 'crypto VC keeps raising.' That is the wrong read. The firm explicitly expanded its mandate to AI and robotics, and that redefinition matters more than the headline. We have underwritten crypto-native venture on specialized domain expertise, and Paradigm's pivot suggests the value proposition is shifting from chain-specific alpha to frontier tech convergence plays where crypto is one component, not the thesis. What sharpens this: Circle secured a national trust bank charter the same week, and Swift put 17 major banks on a blockchain ledger for tokenized deposits. The infrastructure is being built by institutions with balance sheets and regulatory licenses, not by venture-backed startups competing for attention. The market is pricing in a future where stablecoins and tokenized deposits operate within existing financial architecture, not parallel to it. I'd watch whether Paradigm's AI expansion draws LP capital away from pure-play crypto funds, and how that reprices early-stage blockchain infrastructure rounds in Q3. The capital stack is splitting: institutions get the regulated rails, venture gets the speculative frontier. I bet that changes which founders can raise, and on what terms.
